title: rudbeckia columnaris var. tagetes
intro: Rudbeckia columnaris var. tagetes, commonly known as the Black-eyed Susan or Mexican Gold, is a plant species within the Asteraceae family, characterized by its bright yellow flowers and dark center. This plant has been traditionally used in herbal medicine to promote health and well-being, with potential health benefits including reduced inflammation and improved wound healing. The therapeutic actions of Rudbeckia columnaris var. tagetes are thought to be attributed to its bioactive constituents, which include sesquiterpene lactones, flavonoids, and phenolic acids. However, more research is needed to confirm the plant's full range of therapeutic actions and health benefits.
